title: Draw the Journey · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Draw the Journey · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a short familiar journey, such as from home to a park. The lead draws three landmarks in order along a path. The others identify the intended journey and landmark order. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Draw the Journey, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The others identify the intended journey and landmark order.
recall.why: The others identify the intended journey and landmark order.
